page_title: UNI 0-1 LEV | Union Berlin v Bayer Leverkusen 06/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+7' The resulting corner from Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90+6' The resulting corner from Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) is cleared by the defence. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick.

90+6' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Union Berlin.

90+5' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the right side of the net, but Frederik Ronnow leaps like a salmon to deny him.
90+5' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

90+4' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. Bayer Leverkusen get a corner.
90+2' Alex Kral (Union Berlin) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a clever chip pass, but one of the defending players comes up with a timely interception.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
89' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a strong challenge and Benjamin Brand blows for a foul. Union Berlin earn a free kick.
85' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
82' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

81' Josip Juranovic floats a good corner into the box that Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) gets on the end of, but his effort on goal scorches just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bayer Leverkusen will have a goal kick.
81' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) is coming onto the pitch as Brenden Aaronson cannot continue after picking up an injury.

80' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Alex Kral (Union Berlin), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Union Berlin.
79' Nathan Tella is being substituted because of an injury. Xabi Alonso sends Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) on the pitch.
78' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.

77' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he unleashed a powerful shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Frederik Ronnow made a crucial save!
73' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
69' The shots on goal statistics – 0:5.
67' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
67' Substitution. Borja Iglesias makes way for Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen).
66' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
65' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
64' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
63' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Kral (Union Berlin) replaces Andras Schafer.
63' Here is a change. Christopher Trimmel is going off and Nenad Bjelica gives the last tactical orders to Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin).
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) will replace Rani Khedira.
62' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Now Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
60' The resulting corner from Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is cleared.

60' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

59' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the left side of the goal. It's a great effort but an even better save from Frederik Ronnow, who tips the ball around the post. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
57' A player from Bayer Leverkusen commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
57' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) will take the corner.

57' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Bayer Leverkusen will take a corner kick.
54' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
54' Andras Schafer (Union Berlin) unleashed a powerful long-range strike, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Union Berlin.
54' Lukas Hradecky comes off his line to intercept the corner from Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin).

53' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Union Berlin will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
53' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner but it's cleared.
52' The ball is cleared after Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. The ball is out of play. Union Berlin will have a chance to score from a corner.
52' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) goes for goal and shoots towards the left side of the goal, but his effort is well blocked.
48' Bayer Leverkusen control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' Nenad Bjelica has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen comes on the pitch for Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+8' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+8' 0 - 1 Goal! Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Frederik Ronnow into left side of the goal.
45+8' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
45+7' It’s a PENALTY to Bayer Leverkusen after the VAR review!
45+4' Wait! The referee makes the VAR signal and he's going to review that incident in the box from earlier. This could be a penalty for Bayer Leverkusen! Let's see what he decides.
45+4' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Odilon Kossounou (Bayer Leverkusen) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
45+4' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
45+4' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) will take the free kick.

45+3' Benjamin Brand blows his whistle and Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
45+3' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
45+2' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is penalised for a foul. Benjamin Brand had a clear view and blows his whistle.
43' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Frederik Ronnow easily deals with the threat.
41' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

40' Robert Andrich (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.
39' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) takes a short pass in his stride inside the box, but hits a poor shot at goal that goes well wide of the right post.
37' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
37' Benjamin Brand shows a yellow card to Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) for his blatant foul.

36' Christopher Trimmel whips in the corner and finds Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) in space with just the keeper to beat, but somehow he plants his header just past the left post from close in. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
36' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
32' Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) is substituted due to injury. Xabi Alonso gives a chance to Amine Adli.
32' Adam Hlozek (Bayer Leverkusen) picks up an injury.
31' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

28' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Nathan Tella. It's a good effort but just misses the left post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
27' Bayer Leverkusen hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
25' The ratio of the ball possession is 35:65.
23' A pass from Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) is intercepted by Frederik Ronnow and the move breaks down.
21' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Frederik Ronnow intercepts the ball.
18' Neat passing move from Bayer Leverkusen in order to create new attacking opportunities.
16' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

15' Frederik Ronnow makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the roof of the net by Borja Iglesias (Bayer Leverkusen) after a cross from the side. The ball is out of play and Bayer Leverkusen manage to earn a corner.
15' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is able to continue to play.
14' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
12' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

11' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Frederik Ronnow stops the ball from going inside the left post. Bayer Leverkusen force a corner. They send men into the box.
10' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes a direct free kick.
9' Yellow card. Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
9' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul. Bayer Leverkusen get a free kick.
7' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
5' Jonathan Tah (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a rough challenge and Benjamin Brand blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Union Berlin.
3' Borja Iglesias (Bayer Leverkusen) gets a shot from inside the penalty area and it flies just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
1' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Benjamin Brand blows his whistle and it's Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
Union Berlin will kick the game off.
Benjamin Brand will supervise the game today.
